interface.longDescription:

Supported jurisdictions:
Finland
EU

A Laki.ai account is required. Sign in or create an account when connecting to ChatGPT.
capabilities: Research Finnish and EU law and governmental guidance
Navigate complex document relationships with ease, including histories
defaultPrompt: Voiko uutiskirjetilaus olla materiaalin lataamisen ehtona?
Milloin oman asunnon myyntivoitto on verovapaa?
What legal sources can I search and read?

positive.description: Describe Finnish case-law coverage and its limits
positive.expected_behavior: Answer using the returned source-coverage information.

positive.description: Research conditional newsletter consent for a B2B guide download
positive.prompt: Voiko B2B oppaan lataamisen ehdoksi laittaa uutiskirjetilauksen?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer with relevant Finnish and EU provisions, citations and sources displayed in the reader.

positive.description: Relate GDPR access rights to Finnish supplementary provisions
positive.prompt: Etsi rekisteröidyn tarkastusoikeutta koskeva GDPR kohta ja tietosuojalain vastaava. Mikä on näiden suhde?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the relationship and verify whether a corresponding Finnish provision exists. Cite and display the sources.

positive.description: Trace Finnish intra-Community VAT section changes since 2000
positive.prompt: Miten arvonlisäverolain yhteisömyyntiä koskeva pykälä on muuttunut 2000 luvulla?
positive.expected_behavior: Trace the section's changes since 2000, following history pagination. Cite and display the relevant versions.

positive.description: Compare the proposed Act on the Finnish Supervisory Agency in HE 13/2025 with its first in-force wording
positive.prompt: Miten HE 13/2025:ssä ehdotetun Lupa- ja valvontavirastosta annetun lain pykälät muuttuivat esityksestä voimaan tulleeseen versioon?
positive.expected_behavior: Compare the provisions of the first bill in HE 13/2025 (Laki Lupa- ja valvontavirastosta) with the first in-force version of Act 530/2025. Identify changed provisions and explain the changes. Cite and display both versions, state evidence gaps, and use section history if needed to identify the first in-force version.

negative.prompt: What does California law say about non-compete agreements? Cite cases.
negative.expected_behavior: Avoid Laki.ai calls; explain the coverage limit or use another source.

negative.prompt: Käännä englanniksi lause: "Olen menossa kauppaan ostamaan kahvia."
Etsi minulle hyvä asianajaja Helsingistä avioeroasiaan ja anna yhteystiedot.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Laki.ai for lawyer recommendations or contact details.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of the product to ChatGPT Plugins.
